topics.rule_uz: Egalikni ko'rsatish uchun otga 's qo'shiladi (Tom's book — Tomning kitobi). Ko'plik -s bilan tugasa, faqat apostrof qo'yiladi (the boys' room). Possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her, its, our, their.
Subject pronouns (kishilik olmoshlari) gap egasi o'rnida keladi: I (men), you (sen/siz), he (u – erkak), she (u – ayol), it (u – jonsiz/hayvon), we (biz), they (ular).
'A' va 'an' — noaniq artikllar, birlikdagi sanaladigan otlar oldida. Undosh tovush oldida 'a' (a book), unli tovush oldida 'an' (an apple) ishlatiladi.
'Have got' egalik bildiradi (… bor). I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it has got. Inkor: haven't got / hasn't got. So'roq: Have you got...? / Has she got...?
Object pronouns (to'ldiruvchi olmoshlar) fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin keladi: me (meni), you (seni), him (uni – erkak), her (uni – ayol), it (uni), us (bizni), them (ularni).
Joy predloglari narsaning qayerdaligini bildiradi: in (ichida), on (ustida), under (tagida), next to (yonida), behind (orqasida), in front of (oldida), between (orasida).
examples: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.

topics.rule_uz: Ko'plik odatda '-s' qo'shiladi (book → books). '-s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x' bilan tugasa '-es' (box → boxes). Undosh+y bo'lsa, y→i+es (baby → babies). Ba'zilar tartibsiz: man → men, child → children, foot → feet.
Present Continuous hozir sodir bo'layotgan ishni bildiradi. Tuzilishi: am/is/are + fe'l-ing. Inkor: am/is/are + not + -ing. So'roq: Am/Is/Are + ega + -ing?
'Can' qobiliyat yoki ruxsat bildiradi (… ola olmoq). Hamma shaxs uchun bir xil: I/you/he/she/we/they can. Undan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi. Inkor: can't (cannot). So'roq: Can you...?

Past Simple o'tgan zamonda tugagan ishni bildiradi. To'g'ri fe'llarga '-ed' qo'shiladi (play → played). Tartibsiz fe'llar o'zgaradi (go → went, have → had). Inkor: didn't + fe'l. So'roq: Did + ega + fe'l?
Present Perfect o'tmishda bo'lib, hozir bilan bog'liq ishni bildiradi. Tuzilishi: have/has + fe'lning 3-shakli (V3). Inkor: haven't/hasn't + V3. So'roq: Have/Has + ega + V3?
'To be' fe'li (am/is/are) shaxsga qarab o'zgaradi: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are. Inkor: am not / isn't / aren't. So'roq: Am I...? / Is he...? / Are they...?
